sql: SELECT ps.site_source, count(*) AS plants, sum(CASE WHEN ps.est_duns IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_duns, sum(CASE WHEN ps.est_duns IS NOT NULL AND st.duns IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duns_not_registered, sum(CASE WHEN st.duns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS placed FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT duns FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site) st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns GROUP BY ps.site_source ORDER BY plants DESC
